name: The Great Pug
title: Night View Hall
creator: owlboy
description: The Great Pug is a PC-only bar world launched in February 2017 by owlboy, modeled after a real pub called The Great Dane in Madison, Wisconsin. It spans three floors: a ground-floor bar with booths and tables, a second-floor bar and stage area known as Night View Hall with a billiards table, and a top-floor lounge called The Roost with a fireplace and loft seating. It became one of the most iconic early meeting places in VRChat's social and roleplay communities, later spawning a sister world, The Great Pug - West.
